scope: Complete293-entry compilation reconciliation plus60 additional records/leads. Independent primary verification remains incomplete. This is a conditional reference selection, not certification of original deposition at every included site.

principal.definition: Source-qualified climactic Mazama airborne fallout reference: 26 reported point values and three lower bounds. Compilation-supported values are not claimed independently primary-verified. Known corrections, unresolved conflicts, explicit precursor totals, reworked totals and unquantified traces/proxies are omitted. Moss central core uses4 cm; Mount Bachelor UPU>=44 cm, Upper Kirk Road UPU>=35 cm and Portage>=1.27 cm (one-sided interval approximation). Twobit and Lavington use primary coordinates; Green Lake1 cm recovered from primary text. No invented uncertainties, zeros or trace thresholds.

target: Climactic Mazama primary airborne bulk deposit, including co-ignimbrite ash; exclude identified older precursor units and flow/reworked material. Legacy phase correlations remain conditional where primary logs are unavailable.
thickness_convention: Preserved bulk centimetres as a proxy for original local deposition. No universal decompaction correction. Component lower bounds assume in-place primary pumice without depositional thickening.
coordinate_datum: Published decimal or DMS positions used without an undocumented datum conversion; precision does not establish survey accuracy.

prior_release.scope: Current GitHub release preceding the Mazama source revision; the earlier local audit was performed on41b8f2f. Latest five-family results remain accessible at this immutable revision.
